items.title: Ignacio Berroa interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, October 22, 2021 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: There is a famous story with Cab Calloway.

ctx.x: That was sort of my inquiry, like off the bandstand, what got to Dizzy?

No, no, you didn’t want to get into trouble with Dizzy. You didn’t want to run into trouble with Dizzy. Just one story. We were, in 1981 I think we were in a taxicab in Holland, Amsterdam. That was my first trip with him. See we the people that came from Cuba in 1980 through the Mariel boatlift, we didn’t have established in the country in the Ronald Reagan administration gave us a status that we were “in limbo.” No residency, no nothing. We were in limbo. So anyway Dizzy was able to get a permit for me to go…
